CJ dos Santos.note: Santos is goalkeeper cover for Cabo Verde. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
CJ dos Santos.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Dailon Livramento.note: Livramento gives Cabo Verde a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Dailon Livramento.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Deroy Duarte.note: Duarte's World Cup has already included a goal against Argentina. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Deroy Duarte.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Diney Borges.note: Diney has been part of Cabo Verde's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Diney Borges.noteZh: 他在Cabo Verde体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Garry Rodrigues.note: Rodrigues is the forward Cabo Verde can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Garry Rodrigues.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Gilson Benchimol.note: Benchimol is attacking depth for Cabo Verde. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Gilson Benchimol.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Helio Varela.note: Varela is on the scoresheet for Cabo Verde, with his goal coming against Uruguay. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Helio Varela.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Jamiro Monteiro.note: Monteiro gives Cabo Verde structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Jamiro Monteiro.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

João Paulo.note: Paulo gives Cabo Verde cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
João Paulo.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Jovane Cabral.note: Cabral gives Cabo Verde a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Jovane Cabral.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Kelvin Pires.note: Pires gives Cabo Verde cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Kelvin Pires.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Kevin Pina.note: Pina already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Uruguay. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Kevin Pina.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Laros Duarte.note: Duarte is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For Cabo Verde, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Laros Duarte.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Logan Costa.note: Costa is back-line insurance for Cabo Verde. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Logan Costa.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Marcio Rosa.note: Rosa gives Cabo Verde a keeper option if the night turns sideways. His card is about being warm enough for one big save.
Marcio Rosa.noteZh: 他在Cabo Verde首发门将身后等待，但这个角色不是装饰。他要随时处理传中、开球和冷启动。

Nuno da Costa.note: Costa is the forward Cabo Verde can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Nuno da Costa.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Roberto Lopes.note: Lopes has been part of Cabo Verde's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Roberto Lopes.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Ryan Mendes.note: Mendes has supplied one of Cabo Verde's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Ryan Mendes.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为Cabo Verde创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Sidny Lopes Cabral.note: Cabral has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Argentina. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Sidny Lopes Cabral.noteZh: 他已经为Cabo Verde进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Steven Moreira.note: Moreira has been part of Cabo Verde's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Steven Moreira.noteZh: 他给Cabo Verde后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Stopira.summary: Stopira is a Cabo Verde centre-back from SC União Torreense who gives the national team veteran defending, left-footed balance, and set-piece toughness.
Stopira.note: Stopira gives Cabo Verde cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Stopira.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Telmo Arcanjo.note: Arcanjo gives Cabo Verde a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Telmo Arcanjo.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Vozinha.summary: Vozinha is a Cabo Verde goalkeeper from Chaves who gives the national team veteran command, shot stopping, and tournament experience.
Vozinha.note: Vozinha is the last voice in Cabo Verde's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Vozinha.noteZh: 他承担了Cabo Verde的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。

Wagner Pina.note: Pina gives Cabo Verde cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Wagner Pina.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Willy Semedo.note: Semedo is an attacking change-up for Cabo Verde. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Willy Semedo.noteZh: 他是Cabo Verde的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Yannick Semedo.note: Semedo has one tournament assist in the bank for Cabo Verde. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Yannick Semedo.noteZh: 他已经帮Cabo Verde制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。
